name: Thaumaturgy (Soul of the Serpent) — 3 Advanced — Touch of Typhon

system.description:
The Thaumaturge metamorphoses her forearm and hand into a deadly, writhing asp complete with a venomous serpent's head, capable of a lethal bite.

System: The serpent-arm's bite deals aggravated damage on a successful Physical Challenge against a target within close range. A mortal who is slain by the bite has his vitalizing essence drawn into the venom, which coagulates into a small supernatural asp bound to the Thaumaturge's will — the slain mortal's soul finds no rest until that asp is destroyed.
